notes: Each row on the Trials sheet is one AKC event number. Counts are copied from the "Number of Entries" and "Number of Competitors" lines on that event's AKC results page; the link in the last column opens it.
LC Trial = the trial stakes (Open, Specials, Veterans). This is the figure comparable to an ASFA trial entry.
LC Test = Junior Courser and Qualified Courser tests held with the trial. A test entry of 0 means the test was offered and nobody entered. A blank means that event had no test (or no trial).
Entries and competitors are AKC's own labels. Competitors is the lower figure where the two differ.
Scope: "All-breed" events are open to all eligible sighthound breeds. A breed name marks a specialty limited to that breed.

Results posted = No: AKC had not posted results for that event when this was collected (events from September 7 onward, 25 in all). Their entry cells are blank and they are left out of every total. Re-collect later to fill them in.
Excluded: Coursing Ability Tests (CAT) and Fast CAT, which AKC lists as separate event types.
